title: SWF sound export: DefineSound + StartSound tags
description: The SWF compiler currently ignores SoundItem library items and frame SoundLinkage. Add sound export: (1) DefineSound tag (tag 14) for each SoundItem in the library — MP3 data encoded as raw bytes from the dataUri, header fields: SoundId, SoundFormat=2 (MP3), SoundRate/SoundSize/SoundType from item metadata, SoundSampleCount; (2) StartSound tag (tag 15) per keyframe that has a non-null sound field — SoundId + SoundInfo (SyncStop, SyncNoMultiple, HasEnvelope/HasLoops/HasOutPoint/HasInPoint flags as needed); (3) StopSound via SoundInfo.SyncStop flag. For MP3 format (compressionType='mp3'): SoundFormat=2, write SeekSamples UI16 (0) then raw MP3 bytes. For ADPCM: SoundFormat=1. For raw: SoundFormat=0. Wire into compile.ts pre-pass alongside existing DefineShape/DefineFont passes. See SWF spec tags 14+15. Only touches packages/swf/src/ — no authoring-ui changes needed.
